name: Triple
doc: Triple (spell; Double's bigger sibling): one emitter per action - eight runes around the target, two opposite every few ticks, each with its glow, motes and a rising column; the last one's column starts a screen fade and the big rune (sprites, a morphing ring); a flash quad jumps on the target's top; the result. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag021_triple.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Emitter
parts.doc: One per action: its sound, the root going on and the flash at its tick, the result

parts.title: Runes
parts.doc: Eight runes around the target, two opposite a step: their fades, spin, columns and motes

groups.label: Motes
groups.doc: A mote a tick spiralling in, until this tick of its rune; their spiral radius (+ rand 0..0x1FF)

params.label: Release tick
